lines.text: Hi, the walking group will meet by the old clock at nine forty tomorrow morning.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Sorry, could you say that again more slowly? I missed the time.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: Of course. We meet at nine forty. That is twenty minutes before ten.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Nine forty, got it. Where is the old clock? I know the bus station.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: It is next to the main door of the bus station. Look for a tall black clock.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Thanks. So I should wait outside the main door at nine forty?
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: Yes, that is right. I will be there in a green jacket.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Great. I will look for the clock and your green jacket.
lines.speaker: Eli
